lane: formal connective layer (ZeroSet concretization on Mathlib's riemannZeta)
title: 0476: ZetaConcrete lane GREEN - formal/RhAttack/ZetaConcrete.lean (545 lines, 13 theorems + 2 defs) concretizes the abstract B0.lean ZeroSet on Mathlib's ACTUAL riemannZeta zeros: qz.Z = {rho | riemannZeta rho = 0 and rho.im =!= 0}; ALL FIVE structural fields (nonReal, conj, fe, finite + the hqz field of the endpoint) are PROVEN in-tree with NO new axioms; the conj field (closure under complex conjugation) is the hard part and is proven through the Mellin-transform definition of the completed zeta: the a = 0 Hurwitz FE-pair has a real-valued modified kernel, a real kernel + Complex.cpow_conj + Bochner integral commuting with the real-linear isometry star give star(mellin f s) = mellin f (star s) -> star(completedRiemannZeta0 s) = completedRiemannZeta0 (star s) -> riemannZeta (star s) = star(riemannZeta s) (zetaConjSymm) -> non-real zeros close under conjugation (zetaConjZero) - the B25 endpoint rh_program78_stripfront_mach_unifiedContinuumAnchor_PT2 is instantiated at qz with hqz DISCHARGED (ZetaConcrete.hqzQz); the four remaining inputs (hzF the [Z78] #ELEVEN record, honline below 707/50, hPT2 the Platt-Trudgian wire, hOffC the terminal face) remain NAMED INPUTS by design - targeted build 8 766 jobs, full tree 17 454 jobs - NO RH CLAIM (RH qz remains a theorem of the B25 endpoint under its four named inputs; the terminal face stays open).
facts: SCOPE: the five-component audit of the endpoint gap (0467-era) named [Z78], hqz, honline, hZPT2 and the terminal face. This entry discharges exactly ONE of them in-tree: hqz. The concrete zero set qz is the non-real zeros of the pinned Mathlib v4.33.1 riemannZeta object (the same object the CE-window clauses quantify over - the CE clauses were already written against Mathlib's riemannZeta, so qz is the NATURAL concrete instance of the abstract ZeroSet).

THE FIVE FIELDS, PROVEN (no new axioms; pinned Mathlib v4.33.1 read-only infrastructure): (1) nonReal - immediate from the set definition; (2) conj - the hard field: via the Mellin-transform definition of the completed zeta (see the next fact); (3) fe - zetaFeZero: the no-guard product formula riemannZeta_eq_mul_completedRiemannZeta0 + completedRiemannZeta0_one_sub (the completed functional equation) + Gamma/cpow nonvanishing (Complex.Gamma_ne_zero, Complex.cpow_eq_zero_iff) give zeta(rho) = 0 and rho.im =!= 0 -> zeta(1 - rho) = 0; (4) finite - zetaSliceFinite: the slice {rho | zeta rho = 0 and rho.im =!= 0 and 0 < rho.im <= t} sits in the compact rectangle [0,1] x [0,t] intersected with riemannZetaZeros, and IsCompact.inter_riemannZetaZeros_finite (with isClosed_riemannZetaZeros) makes it finite; (5) hqz - hqzQz: forall rho in qz.Z, riemannZeta rho = 0, now DERIVED, not assumed.

THE CONJ FIELD (the contribution): chain of local lemmas - normStar (conjugation is norm-preserving, via normSq_apply/norm_mul_self_eq_normSq), starL (conjugation as a continuous real-linear map on C), integrableStar (an isometry preserves Bochner integrability), starMellinOfReal (star (mellin f s) = mellin f (star s) for a real-valued kernel f: the integrand (t : C)^(s-1) commutes with star because t > 0 has arg 0 =!= pi (Complex.cpow_conj + the Complex.star_def bridge between starRingEnd notation and StarRing notation), and star moves through the Bochner integral via ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm), hurwitzEvenFEPair0FModifReal (the a = 0 Hurwitz FE-pair modified kernel f_modif is real-valued: f = ofReal (evenKernel 0), f0 = g0 = eps = 1, k = 1/2, so both indicator branches are real), completedRiemannZeta0Conj (star (completedRiemannZeta0 s) = completedRiemannZeta0 (star s) - the completed zeta is real-symmetric), zetaConjSymm (riemannZeta (star s) = star (riemannZeta s) for ALL s, no guard: the product formula + completedRiemannZeta0Conj + Complex.Gamma_conj + Complex.cpow_conj at (pi : C)), zetaConjZero (a non-real zero is conjugate-closed). Every step is a local lemma in the module; the only Mathlib facts used are the pinned read-only ones named in the module header.

WHY THE MELLIN ROUTE: the alternative routes were audited first and rejected or deferred - (a) a direct series-on-Re(s) > 1 + identity-theorem route needed a tsum-conjugation lemma and a holomorphic identity theorem neither present in the pinned Mathlib under a usable name; (b) the L-series framework contains no direct WeakFEPair conjugation theorem (grepped: no star/conj symmetry lemma for Lambda0). The Mellin route needed only: a real-kernel fact (proved), cpow conjugation at positive real base (Complex.cpow_conj, present), Gamma conjugation (Complex.Gamma_conj, present), and star-through-Bochner-integral (ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm, present) - so the entire gap closed with LOCAL lemmas and no missing infrastructure.

THE ENDPOINT: ZetaConcrete.rh_program78_qz_continuumAnchor_PT2 (hzF : Z78ContinuumAnchor.externalZeroFree78ContinuumAnchor) (honline : forall rho in qz.Z, 0 < |rho.im| and |rho.im| < 707/50 -> rho.re = 1/2) (Qside : R x R -> R) (hPT2 : WinC.allOnLineUpTo qz WinC.tPT2) (hOffC : forall t0 d0, tPT2 <= t0 -> 0 < d0 -> d0 <= continuumAnchorD0max -> not (P12.offPair qz t0 d0)) : B0.RH qz. This is EXACTLY the B25 endpoint (RHEnd.rh_program78_stripfront_mach_unifiedContinuumAnchor_PT2) with q := qz and hqz := ZetaConcrete.hqzQz; the other four inputs are unchanged named inputs. The residual endpoint gap is now FOUR named components: hzF, honline, hPT2, hOffC (the terminal face - the NAMED OPEN RESEARCH OBJECT).

HONESTY BOUNDARY: no RH claim anywhere in the module or this entry. RH qz is not asserted; it is a theorem of the B25 endpoint under its four named inputs, exactly as before this module. The terminal face above the certified frontier (tCE141 at publication of the parallel entry 0475) remains open. zetaNontrivialInStrip (0 < rho.re < 1 for non-real zeros) is proven as a corollary of the fe-field machinery + riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re - it is a standard classical fact, not an RH component, and is not used to assert RH.

BUILD: targeted RhAttack.ZetaConcrete: 8 766 jobs, 0 errors (linter warnings only). Full tree: 17 454 jobs, 0 errors. Temporary probe files (ProbeConj.lean, ProbeIntegral.lean) removed before commit; the final commit contains only the module + docs.

MATHLIB API LESSONS RECORDED (for future sessions): in the pinned build, Complex.conj and star are related by Complex.star_def : (Star.star : C -> C) = conj (function equality, not definitional); many rewrites need an explicit bridge. star_two is not simp-normal (proved via star_add/star_one); real-scalar star-smul needs change + star_mul + conj_ofReal + ring. hasFiniteIntegral_congr' needs true forall-m-norm equalities. Set.Finite.subset (not Finite.mono). ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm bridges (starL : C -> C) applications to star. ring [h] does not use h - use linear_combination or explicit rewrites.
